user.title: ALPR-RU
user.description: Select a Home Assistant camera and, optionally, a binary_sensor that will automatically start recognition when it turns on.

data_description.trigger_entity: Optional. When the selected binary_sensor changes from off to on, a frame is captured from the selected camera and sent to ALPR-RU.

error.cannot_get_camera_image: Unable to capture an image from the selected camera: {error}

abort.single_instance_allowed: ALPR-RU is already configured. Open Configure to change its settings.

init.title: Configure ALPR-RU
init.description: Configure recognition and, optionally, automatic gate opening for whitelisted license plates.

data_description.trigger_entity: Recognition starts only when the selected binary_sensor changes from off to on. Leave empty for manual recognition only.
data_description.access_enabled: Disabled by default. Enable only after testing recognition and the selected gate entity.
data_description.allowed_plates: One plate per line or separated by commas/spaces. Cyrillic and Latin characters are normalized automatically.
data_description.gate_entity: Supports switch.*, button.* and cover.*. switch uses turn_on, button uses press, cover uses open_cover.
data_description.min_confidence: The plate must be whitelisted, have a valid format and meet this confidence threshold.
data_description.gate_cooldown: Prevents repeated gate commands during a burst of recognition events.
